channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: How the Outer Sunset’s real estate market is surfing the white-collar wave
item.description: Seven-figure listings, new restaurants, and a changing guard signal a beachfront shift at the city’s west side.

item.title: All the ways San Franciscans are finding joy amidst the chaos
item.description: Answers from our recent live podcast taping ranged from “learn piano” and “make pizza” to “do more drugs” and “quit my job.”

item.title: A new pro volleyball team wants in on San Francisco’s women’s sports boom
item.description: League One Volleyball is expanding to the Bay Area, and team president Stephanie Martin sees an opportunity to thrive.

item.title: Raheem Morris could be the 49ers’ long-term solution as defensive coordinator
item.description: After multiple failed stints as a head coach, Morris is reuniting with Kyle Shanahan in San Francisco.

item.title: Lurie doesn’t run SF’s school district. Parents could blame him for teachers strike anyway
item.description: If history is a lesson, the mayor won’t evade responsibility for a work stoppage.

item.title: A Super Bowl quarterback who’s never been sacked
item.description: Zaileen Janmohamed, the head of the Bay Area Host Committee, walked a high-wire path to this year’s big game. Next up: the World Cup and, possibly, the Olympic Games.

item.title: More is more: Maximalism has come for your morning coffee
item.description: From espresso cream clouds to cake-batter lattes, Bay Area cafes are serving increasingly Instagrammable, over-the-top creations.

item.title: The A’s already have what the Giants really want
item.description: Buster Posey is trying to build the type of homegrown core that A’s GM David Forst has assembled.

item.title: Al Guido exclusive: New 49ers CEO discusses promotion, vision for team’s future
item.description: Jed York, the team’s principal owner, named Guido as top exec after a 10-year run as president.

item.title: Wiener has pole position in money race for Pelosi’s Congress seat
item.description: The three-way bout is shaping up to be the most expensive race on the June ballot.
